ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee and issue the rider a $6.61 Ryde voucher (NS-7); send the driver's account to Ryde review for the false "I'm Here" arrival tap + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: Pressing "I'm Here" is only NS-1(i); the tap does not validate itself. GPS shows the tap was made 350 m from the pickup with 0 s inside the 200 m zone afterwards [F5], and the closest approach ever was 288 m [F1], so NS-1(ii) fails and NS-2 applies [NS-1][NS-2].

The 4 min 0 s stationary period occurred 350 m from the pickup point, not at it [F2], so it does not satisfy the "waited at the pick-up point" element of NS-1(iii); duration alone cannot cure the failed location element [NS-1].

The chat notice of presence [F9] is contradicted by the GPS record that the driver was 350 m away and never entered 200 m [F2][F1]; system records override chat statements, so the "real chance to board" narrative fails on NS-1(ii) [NS-1][NS-2].
Absence of traffic incidents and fair weather [F14][F15] is irrelevant to a no-show claim under NS-1; nothing there cures the missing "at the pickup point" element shown by F1 and F4 [NS-1].

A correct published amount is not entitlement: NS-0/NS-1 allow the $6.61 only if (i)-(iii) all hold, and the tap 350 m away with 0 s inside the zone [F5] plus the null platform arrival record [F4] break (ii) and (iii) regardless of the rider's clean record [F16] [NS-0][NS-1][NS-2].

The rider's remedy is not a discretionary goodwill waiver: NS-2 makes the fee refundable once NS-1(ii) fails; the driver's prior upheld no-show [F17] is used only as supporting weight for the account action, never to decide the outcome [NS-2].
